content: I have a Pull Guide too

The Rule-Set for the Myriad Self-Selection Banner 

- 30 Pulls for a guarantee on the Rate Up
- Banner is shared between Awakeners & WoDs
- Cannot obtain Standard Awakeners + WoDs
- Every time that you pull either Awakener / WoD twice in a row, the following SSR Pull is guaranteed to belong to the other Category

Normally, you'd be able to

Character Banner
- Every 90 Pulls / 3rd SSR Character to appear is guaranteed to be the Rate Up Character
- Standard Characters are available in the Banner

Weapon Banner 
- Every 60 Pulls / 2nd SSR Weapon to appear is guaranteed to be the Rate Up Weapon
- Standard Weapons are available in the Banner
